missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Рубль' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'подорожал'. 'Российский' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'снова' marks repetition.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Рубль' is the accusative object of 'дай'; this inanimate masculine noun keeps the nominative form. 'Один' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Рубля' is the genitive required by 'нет', strengthened by 'ни' to mean not a single one.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Рублю' is the dative form after 'к', expressing the rate relative to the ruble. 'Курс доллара' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Рублём' is the instrumental expressing what he paid with. 'Последним' agrees with it in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О рубле' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Слабом' agrees in the prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. After 'два', the noun takes 'рубля', the genitive singular used with two, three, and four. 'Хлеб' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Рубли' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'лежат'. 'Последние' agrees in the plural, and 'в кошельке' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a large number. After 'сто', the noun takes the genitive plural 'рублей'. 'У меня' shows whose money it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative of price. 'Рубль' is the accusative used to state the cost; with 'один' the form matches the nominative. 'Этот сувенир' is the subject.
